The amount requested in the token transfer ('lenderFee') is credited to 'protocolFeeBalance' without verifying the balance actually received. A fee-on-transfer or rebasing token makes the recorded credit diverge from real holdings, letting a counterparty over-credit and redirect funds; read balanceOf(address(this)) deltas instead.
